description.zh:
阻断类型。取值：
- **close**：封禁
- **captcha**：人机识别
description.en:
The blocking type. Valid values:

- **close**: block

- **captcha**: bot detection

description.zh: 单一IP访问次数。取值范围：**2**~**2000**。
description.en: The number of access attempts from a single IP address. Valid values: **2** to **2000**.

description.zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain name of the website business.

> The domain name must have a configured website business forwarding rule. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.
The detection duration. Valid values: **5** to **10800**. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
匹配模式。取值：
- **prefix**：前缀匹配
- **match**：完全匹配
description.en:
The matching pattern. Valid values:

- **prefix**: prefix match

- **match**: exact match

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The resource group ID to which the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance belongs in the Resource Management product. The default value is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.
The blocking duration. Valid values: **60** to **86400**. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
检测路径。
> URI不支持修改。网站业务的域名，检测路径，规则名称唯一确定一条规则。
description.en:
The detection path.

> The URI cannot be modified. A rule is uniquely identified by the domain name of the website business, the detection path, and the rule name.

title.zh: 编辑网站业务CC防护自定义规则

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo modify-web-cc-rule --resource-group-id default --domain www.aliyun.com --name testrule --act close --count 3 --interval 30 --biz-mode prefix --ttl 60 --uri /abc --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddoscoo ModifyWebCCRule --region cn-hangzhou --Act close --ResourceGroupId default --Mode prefix --Count 3 --Domain 'www.aliyun.com' --Ttl 60 --Uri '/abc' --Name testrule --Interval 30
